title: Don't Swim
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 3\leq N \leq 10^5; |x_i|,|y_i|,|s_x|,|s_y|,|t_x|,|t_y|\leq 10^9; (x_1,y_1),(x_2,y_2),\ldots, and (x_N,y_N) form a convex polygon in counterclockwise order.; No three points of C are colinear.; S and T are outside C and not on the circumference of C.; All values in the input are integers.
